# PW04 common library (literature + exact/numeric replay only).  python3 -I; numpy/scipy/mpmath.
import mpmath as mp, numpy as np, json, sys, hashlib
mp.mp.dps = 80
MPF = mp.mpf

# ---------- nodes / parameters ----------
def cheb_nodes(s):                      # BIT (5.8): c_i = cos((2s+1-2i)pi/(2s)) / cos(pi/(2s))
    return [mp.cos((2*s+1-2*i)*mp.pi/(2*s))/mp.cos(mp.pi/(2*s)) for i in range(1, s+1)]
def sigma_sup(s):                       # BIT Remark 2.1 : (s-2) x^(s-1) - (s-1) x^(s-2) - 1 = 0, root > 1
    f = lambda x: (s-2)*x**(s-1) - (s-1)*x**(s-2) - 1
    lo, hi = MPF(1), MPF(4)             # f(1) = -2 < 0 ; f(4) > 0 for s>=3
    for _ in range(300):
        mid = (lo+hi)/2
        if f(mid) > 0: hi = mid
        else: lo = mid
    return (lo+hi)/2
def g1_of(s): return 1 - 1/sigma_sup(s)  # (1-g1) sigma_sup = 1

# ---------- Route 1: BIT matrix formulas (2.4),(2.5) : Theta = V S P V^-1, E = V D F0^T V^-1, B = Theta - sigma A E ----------
def vander(c):
    s = len(c); return mp.matrix([[c[i]**j for j in range(s)] for i in range(s)])
def route1(c, gam, sg):
    s = len(c); V = vander(c); Vi = V**-1
    S = mp.diag([sg**j for j in range(s)])
    P = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s):
        for j in range(i, s): P[i, j] = mp.binomial(j, i)
    D = mp.diag([k+1 for k in range(s)])
    F0 = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(1, s): F0[i, i-1] = 1
    Th = V*S*P*Vi
    E = V*D*F0.T*Vi
    G = mp.diag(gam)
    Gm = -G*Th; A = -Gm
    B = Th - sg*A*E
    return dict(Theta=Th, Gamma=Gm, A=A, B=B, E=E)

# ---------- Route 2: direct Lagrange/polynomial form of Gamma(s),AB(s)  (BIT (3.1)); no Vandermonde inverse ----------
def lag(c, j, x):
    r = MPF(1)
    for k in range(len(c)):
        if k != j: r *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
    return r
def dlag(c, j, x):
    s = len(c); tot = MPF(0)
    for m in range(s):
        if m == j: continue
        t = 1/(c[j]-c[m])
        for k in range(s):
            if k != j and k != m: t *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
        tot += t
    return tot
def route2(c, gam, sg):
    s = len(c); Th = mp.matrix(s, s); B = mp.matrix(s, s); A = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s):
        x = 1+sg*c[i]
        for j in range(s):
            Th[i, j] = lag(c, j, x)
            A[i, j] = gam[i]*Th[i, j]                       # A = -Gamma = G Theta
            B[i, j] = Th[i, j] - gam[i]*sg*dlag(c, j, x)    # (3.1) AB: b_ij p(c_j) = p(1+sg c_i) - gam_i sg p'(1+sg c_i)
    return dict(Theta=Th, A=A, B=B)

# ---------- Route 3: BIT (2.15)  B~ = (I - g1 Dhat - g0 F0^T Dhat) S P, B = V B~ V^-1 ----------
def route3(c, g0, g1, sg):
    s = len(c); V = vander(c); Vi = V**-1
    S = mp.diag([sg**j for j in range(s)])
    P = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s):
        for j in range(i, s): P[i, j] = mp.binomial(j, i)
    Dh = mp.diag([k for k in range(s)])
    F0 = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(1, s): F0[i, i-1] = 1
    Bt = (mp.eye(s) - g1*Dh - g0*F0.T*Dh)*S*P
    return dict(Btilde=Bt, B=V*Bt*Vi, V=V, Vi=Vi)

def mdiff(X, Y): return max(abs(X[i, j]-Y[i, j]) for i in range(X.rows) for j in range(X.cols))
def mp2np(M): return np.array([[float(M[i, j]) for j in range(M.cols)] for i in range(M.rows)])

# ---------- (4.7) superconvergence condition on g0 ----------
def v_tilde(s, g0, g1):                 # left eigvec (size s+1) of the (s+1)x(s+1) triangular B~(sigma=1), eigenvalue 1, v1=1
    n = s+1
    S = mp.eye(n); P = mp.matrix(n, n)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n): P[i, j] = mp.binomial(j, i)
    Dh = mp.diag([k for k in range(n)]); F0 = mp.matrix(n, n)
    for i in range(1, n): F0[i, i-1] = 1
    Bt = (mp.eye(n) - g1*Dh - g0*F0.T*Dh)*S*P
    v = [MPF(0)]*n; v[0] = MPF(1)
    for j in range(1, n):
        acc = sum(v[i]*Bt[i, j] for i in range(j))
        v[j] = acc/(1-Bt[j, j])           # v_j (B~_jj - 1) + sum_{i<j} v_i B~_ij = 0
    return v
def resid47(c, g0, g1):                  # (4.7): v~ . (phi_0..phi_{s-1}, 1)
    s = len(c); v = v_tilde(s, g0, g1)
    # node polynomial coefficients phi_0..phi_s (phi_s = 1)
    co = [MPF(1)]
    for ci in c:
        new = [MPF(0)]*(len(co)+1)
        for k, a in enumerate(co): new[k+1] += a; new[k] -= ci*a
        co = new
    return sum(v[k]*co[k] for k in range(s+1))
def g0_roots_47(c, g1, lo=None, hi=4, n=800):
    # roots of a polynomial in g0 (degree <= s): interpolate exactly through s+1 points, then polyroots
    s = len(c); pts = [MPF(k)/2 for k in range(s+1)]
    vals = [resid47(c, p, g1) for p in pts]
    # Newton-form -> monomial via solving Vandermonde
    Vm = mp.matrix([[p**k for k in range(s+1)] for p in pts]); co = mp.lu_solve(Vm, mp.matrix(vals))
    rts = mp.polyroots([co[k] for k in range(s, -1, -1)], maxsteps=500, extraprec=400)
    return sorted([mp.re(r) for r in rts if abs(mp.im(r)) < mp.mpf(10)**-40], key=lambda x: x)
# alternative route for g0 :  v^T w = 0 with v left eigvec (v^T 1 = 1) of nodal B(1) and w_i = phi(1+c_i) - gam_i phi'(1+c_i)   (BIT (4.5))
def resid_nodal(c, g0, g1):
    s = len(c); gam = [g0+g1*ci for ci in c]
    B = route2(c, gam, MPF(1))['B']
    Bn = mp2np(B)
    # left eigenvector for eigenvalue 1 by exact solve in mp:  v^T (B - I) = 0, v^T 1 = 1
    M = (B - mp.eye(s)).T
    M2 = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s-1):
        for j in range(s): M2[i, j] = M[i, j]
    for j in range(s): M2[s-1, j] = 1
    rhs = mp.matrix([0]*(s-1)+[1]); v = mp.lu_solve(M2, rhs)
    phi = lambda x: mp.fprod([x-ci for ci in c])
    dphi = lambda x: mp.fsum(mp.fprod([x-ck for k, ck in enumerate(c) if k != m]) for m in range(s))
    w = [phi(1+c[i]) - gam[i]*dphi(1+c[i]) for i in range(s)]
    return mp.fsum(v[i]*w[i] for i in range(s))

# ---------- numpy (double) coefficient evaluation for experiments ----------
def lag_np(c, x):
    s = len(c); L = np.ones((len(x), s)); dL = np.zeros((len(x), s))
    for j in range(s):
        for k in range(s):
            if k != j: L[:, j] *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
        for m in range(s):
            if m == j: continue
            t = np.ones(len(x))/(c[j]-c[m])
            for k in range(s):
                if k != j and k != m: t *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
            dL[:, j] += t
    return L, dL
def coef_np(c, gam, sg):
    c = np.asarray(c, float); gam = np.asarray(gam, float)
    x = 1+sg*c; L, dL = lag_np(c, x)
    A = gam[:, None]*L; B = L - gam[:, None]*sg*dL
    return B, A
def alpha_deg(B, gam, nphi=721, nr=500, rlo=-6, rhi=10):
    rs = np.logspace(rlo, rhi, nr); g = np.asarray(gam, float)
    def f(p):
        z = rs*np.exp(1j*(np.pi-np.radians(p)))
        M = (1.0/(1.0-z[:, None]*g[None, :]))[:, :, None]*B[None, :, :]
        return float(np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(M))))
    prev = 0.0
    for p in np.linspace(0, 90, nphi):
        if f(p) >= 1+1e-13:
            lo, hi = prev, p
            for _ in range(40):
                m = 0.5*(lo+hi)
                if f(m) >= 1+1e-13: hi = m
                else: lo = m
            return lo
        prev = p
    return 90.0
def rho(M): return float(np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(M))))

# ---------- method definitions ----------
P26 = dict(c=["-1.702","-0.51","-0.195797762","0.155193392","0.755672784","1"],
  g0=["0.214789562","0.249182503","0.237832565","0.245204742","0.353848357"],
  g1=["0.566334104","0.496228487","0.518584061","0.498857638","0.502412430"])   # APNUM 48 PPSW2-6 (PW03A/PW03B recovery)
def gam_ppsw2(c, g0, g1, sg):            # APNUM (3.8) i<s ; (3.6) i=s
    s = len(c); g = [g0[i]/(1+sg*g1[i]) for i in range(s-1)]
    g.append(1/(sg*sum(1/(1+sg-cj) for cj in c))); return g
def mipeer_params(s, g0=None):
    c = cheb_nodes(s); g1 = g1_of(s)
    if g0 is None:
        rts = g0_roots_47(c, g1); lb = -g1*min(c)
        g0 = [r for r in rts if r > lb][0]
    return c, g0, g1
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b if isinstance(b, bytes) else b.encode()).hexdigest()
# PW04-M1: printed-vs-reconstructed audit of BIT Table 7.1 / (2.17), g0 from (4.7) by two routes, and the s=5 g0 discrepancy.
mp.mp.dps = 80
out = {}
printed71 = {3: (0.5858, 0.9057, 90.0), 4: (0.4039, 0.5443, 90.0), 5: (0.3075, 0.3756, 89.8)}
printed217 = {3: (2.414, 0.5858), 4: (1.678, 0.4039), 5: (1.444, 0.3075), 6: (1.330, 0.2481), 7: (1.262, 0.2078), 8: (1.218, 0.1788)}
# (2.17) check for s=3..8
t217 = {}
for s in range(3, 9):
    ss = sigma_sup(s); g1 = 1-1/ss
    t217[s] = dict(sigma_sup=mp.nstr(ss, 20), g1=mp.nstr(g1, 20), printed=printed217[s],
                   round4_match=(abs(float(ss)-printed217[s][0]) <= 0.0005+1e-12 and abs(float(g1)-printed217[s][1]) <= 0.00005+1e-12))
out["table_2_17_check"] = t217
# Table 5.1 K_C check: Frobenius cond of V for nodes (5.8) is  cond_F(S(nu)^-1 Psi) = cond_F(V)  (Lemma 5.1)
printedKC = {3: 4.5826, 4: 10.919, 5: 26.328, 6: 63.641, 7: 154.01, 8: 372.73}
kc = {}
for s in range(3, 9):
    c = cheb_nodes(s); V = vander(c); Vi = V**-1
    kc[s] = dict(cond_F_V=mp.nstr(mp.sqrt(mp.fsum(V[i, j]**2 for i in range(s) for j in range(s)))*mp.sqrt(mp.fsum(Vi[i, j]**2 for i in range(s) for j in range(s))), 8), printed=printedKC[s])
out["table_5_1_KC_check"] = kc
# g0 : route (a) polynomial (4.7) with v~ ; route (b) nodal left eigenvector (4.5)
res = {}
for s in (3, 4, 5, 6, 7):

    rb = [mp.findroot(lambda g: resid_nodal(c, g, g1), r, tol=MPF(10)**-60, maxsteps=100) for r in ra]
    lb = -g1*min(c)
    res[s] = dict(g1=mp.nstr(g1, 30), g0_roots_route_a=[mp.nstr(r, 40) for r in ra], g0_roots_route_b=[mp.nstr(r, 40) for r in rb],
                  max_abs_diff_a_b=mp.nstr(max(abs(x-y) for x, y in zip(ra, rb)), 5), lower_bound_2_18=mp.nstr(lb, 20),
                  admissible=[mp.nstr(r, 12) for r in ra if r > lb], printed=printed71.get(s))
out["g0_roots"] = res

# PW04 common library (literature + exact/numeric replay only).  python3 -I; numpy/scipy/mpmath.
import mpmath as mp, numpy as np, json, sys, hashlib
mp.mp.dps = 80
MPF = mp.mpf

# ---------- nodes / parameters ----------
def cheb_nodes(s):                      # BIT (5.8): c_i = cos((2s+1-2i)pi/(2s)) / cos(pi/(2s))
    return [mp.cos((2*s+1-2*i)*mp.pi/(2*s))/mp.cos(mp.pi/(2*s)) for i in range(1, s+1)]
def sigma_sup(s):                       # BIT Remark 2.1 : (s-2) x^(s-1) - (s-1) x^(s-2) - 1 = 0, root > 1
    f = lambda x: (s-2)*x**(s-1) - (s-1)*x**(s-2) - 1
    lo, hi = MPF(1), MPF(4)             # f(1) = -2 < 0 ; f(4) > 0 for s>=3
    for _ in range(300):
        mid = (lo+hi)/2
        if f(mid) > 0: hi = mid
        else: lo = mid
    return (lo+hi)/2
def g1_of(s): return 1 - 1/sigma_sup(s)  # (1-g1) sigma_sup = 1

# ---------- Route 1: BIT matrix formulas (2.4),(2.5) : Theta = V S P V^-1, E = V D F0^T V^-1, B = Theta - sigma A E ----------
def vander(c):
    s = len(c); return mp.matrix([[c[i]**j for j in range(s)] for i in range(s)])
def route1(c, gam, sg):
    s = len(c); V = vander(c); Vi = V**-1
    S = mp.diag([sg**j for j in range(s)])
    P = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s):
        for j in range(i, s): P[i, j] = mp.binomial(j, i)
    D = mp.diag([k+1 for k in range(s)])
    F0 = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(1, s): F0[i, i-1] = 1
    Th = V*S*P*Vi
    E = V*D*F0.T*Vi
    G = mp.diag(gam)
    Gm = -G*Th; A = -Gm
    B = Th - sg*A*E
    return dict(Theta=Th, Gamma=Gm, A=A, B=B, E=E)

# ---------- Route 2: direct Lagrange/polynomial form of Gamma(s),AB(s)  (BIT (3.1)); no Vandermonde inverse ----------
def lag(c, j, x):
    r = MPF(1)
    for k in range(len(c)):
        if k != j: r *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
    return r
def dlag(c, j, x):
    s = len(c); tot = MPF(0)
    for m in range(s):
        if m == j: continue
        t = 1/(c[j]-c[m])
        for k in range(s):
            if k != j and k != m: t *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
        tot += t
    return tot
def route2(c, gam, sg):
    s = len(c); Th = mp.matrix(s, s); B = mp.matrix(s, s); A = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s):
        x = 1+sg*c[i]
        for j in range(s):
            Th[i, j] = lag(c, j, x)
            A[i, j] = gam[i]*Th[i, j]                       # A = -Gamma = G Theta
            B[i, j] = Th[i, j] - gam[i]*sg*dlag(c, j, x)    # (3.1) AB: b_ij p(c_j) = p(1+sg c_i) - gam_i sg p'(1+sg c_i)
    return dict(Theta=Th, A=A, B=B)

# ---------- Route 3: BIT (2.15)  B~ = (I - g1 Dhat - g0 F0^T Dhat) S P, B = V B~ V^-1 ----------
def route3(c, g0, g1, sg):
    s = len(c); V = vander(c); Vi = V**-1
    S = mp.diag([sg**j for j in range(s)])
    P = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s):
        for j in range(i, s): P[i, j] = mp.binomial(j, i)
    Dh = mp.diag([k for k in range(s)])
    F0 = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(1, s): F0[i, i-1] = 1
    Bt = (mp.eye(s) - g1*Dh - g0*F0.T*Dh)*S*P
    return dict(Btilde=Bt, B=V*Bt*Vi, V=V, Vi=Vi)

def mdiff(X, Y): return max(abs(X[i, j]-Y[i, j]) for i in range(X.rows) for j in range(X.cols))
def mp2np(M): return np.array([[float(M[i, j]) for j in range(M.cols)] for i in range(M.rows)])

# ---------- (4.7) superconvergence condition on g0 ----------
def v_tilde(s, g0, g1):                 # left eigvec (size s+1) of the (s+1)x(s+1) triangular B~(sigma=1), eigenvalue 1, v1=1
    n = s+1
    S = mp.eye(n); P = mp.matrix(n, n)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n): P[i, j] = mp.binomial(j, i)
    Dh = mp.diag([k for k in range(n)]); F0 = mp.matrix(n, n)
    for i in range(1, n): F0[i, i-1] = 1
    Bt = (mp.eye(n) - g1*Dh - g0*F0.T*Dh)*S*P
    v = [MPF(0)]*n; v[0] = MPF(1)
    for j in range(1, n):
        acc = sum(v[i]*Bt[i, j] for i in range(j))
        v[j] = acc/(1-Bt[j, j])           # v_j (B~_jj - 1) + sum_{i<j} v_i B~_ij = 0
    return v
def resid47(c, g0, g1):                  # (4.7): v~ . (phi_0..phi_{s-1}, 1)
    s = len(c); v = v_tilde(s, g0, g1)
    # node polynomial coefficients phi_0..phi_s (phi_s = 1)
    co = [MPF(1)]
    for ci in c:
        new = [MPF(0)]*(len(co)+1)
        for k, a in enumerate(co): new[k+1] += a; new[k] -= ci*a
        co = new
    return sum(v[k]*co[k] for k in range(s+1))
def g0_roots_47(c, g1, lo=None, hi=4, n=800):
    # roots of a polynomial in g0 (degree <= s): interpolate exactly through s+1 points, then polyroots
    s = len(c); pts = [MPF(k)/2 for k in range(s+1)]
    vals = [resid47(c, p, g1) for p in pts]
    # Newton-form -> monomial via solving Vandermonde
    Vm = mp.matrix([[p**k for k in range(s+1)] for p in pts]); co = mp.lu_solve(Vm, mp.matrix(vals))
    rts = mp.polyroots([co[k] for k in range(s, -1, -1)], maxsteps=500, extraprec=400)
    return sorted([mp.re(r) for r in rts if abs(mp.im(r)) < mp.mpf(10)**-40], key=lambda x: x)
# alternative route for g0 :  v^T w = 0 with v left eigvec (v^T 1 = 1) of nodal B(1) and w_i = phi(1+c_i) - gam_i phi'(1+c_i)   (BIT (4.5))
def resid_nodal(c, g0, g1):
    s = len(c); gam = [g0+g1*ci for ci in c]
    B = route2(c, gam, MPF(1))['B']
    Bn = mp2np(B)
    # left eigenvector for eigenvalue 1 by exact solve in mp:  v^T (B - I) = 0, v^T 1 = 1
    M = (B - mp.eye(s)).T
    M2 = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s-1):
        for j in range(s): M2[i, j] = M[i, j]
    for j in range(s): M2[s-1, j] = 1
    rhs = mp.matrix([0]*(s-1)+[1]); v = mp.lu_solve(M2, rhs)
    phi = lambda x: mp.fprod([x-ci for ci in c])
    dphi = lambda x: mp.fsum(mp.fprod([x-ck for k, ck in enumerate(c) if k != m]) for m in range(s))
    w = [phi(1+c[i]) - gam[i]*dphi(1+c[i]) for i in range(s)]
    return mp.fsum(v[i]*w[i] for i in range(s))

# ---------- numpy (double) coefficient evaluation for experiments ----------
def lag_np(c, x):
    s = len(c); L = np.ones((len(x), s)); dL = np.zeros((len(x), s))
    for j in range(s):
        for k in range(s):
            if k != j: L[:, j] *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
        for m in range(s):
            if m == j: continue
            t = np.ones(len(x))/(c[j]-c[m])
            for k in range(s):
                if k != j and k != m: t *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
            dL[:, j] += t
    return L, dL
def coef_np(c, gam, sg):
    c = np.asarray(c, float); gam = np.asarray(gam, float)
    x = 1+sg*c; L, dL = lag_np(c, x)
    A = gam[:, None]*L; B = L - gam[:, None]*sg*dL
    return B, A
def alpha_deg(B, gam, nphi=721, nr=500, rlo=-6, rhi=10):
    rs = np.logspace(rlo, rhi, nr); g = np.asarray(gam, float)
    def f(p):
        z = rs*np.exp(1j*(np.pi-np.radians(p)))
        M = (1.0/(1.0-z[:, None]*g[None, :]))[:, :, None]*B[None, :, :]
        return float(np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(M))))
    prev = 0.0
    for p in np.linspace(0, 90, nphi):
        if f(p) >= 1+1e-13:
            lo, hi = prev, p
            for _ in range(40):
                m = 0.5*(lo+hi)
                if f(m) >= 1+1e-13: hi = m
                else: lo = m
            return lo
        prev = p
    return 90.0
def rho(M): return float(np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(M))))

# ---------- method definitions ----------
P26 = dict(c=["-1.702","-0.51","-0.195797762","0.155193392","0.755672784","1"],
  g0=["0.214789562","0.249182503","0.237832565","0.245204742","0.353848357"],
  g1=["0.566334104","0.496228487","0.518584061","0.498857638","0.502412430"])   # APNUM 48 PPSW2-6 (PW03A/PW03B recovery)
def gam_ppsw2(c, g0, g1, sg):            # APNUM (3.8) i<s ; (3.6) i=s
    s = len(c); g = [g0[i]/(1+sg*g1[i]) for i in range(s-1)]
    g.append(1/(sg*sum(1/(1+sg-cj) for cj in c))); return g
def mipeer_params(s, g0=None):
    c = cheb_nodes(s); g1 = g1_of(s)
    if g0 is None:
        rts = g0_roots_47(c, g1); lb = -g1*min(c)
        g0 = [r for r in rts if r > lb][0]
    return c, g0, g1
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b if isinstance(b, bytes) else b.encode()).hexdigest()
# PW04-M2: full mipeer6 tableau (BIT 2005 reconstruction), three independent routes, dps=80; stability data.
mp.mp.dps = 80
s = 6
c, g0, g1 = mipeer_params(s)
gam = [g0+g1*ci for ci in c]
out = dict(s=s, nodes=[mp.nstr(x, 60) for x in c], nodes_exact="c = (-1, -(sqrt3-1), -(2-sqrt3), 2-sqrt3, sqrt3-1, 1)",
           sigma_sup=mp.nstr(sigma_sup(s), 60), g1=mp.nstr(g1, 60), g0=mp.nstr(g0, 60),
           gamma=[mp.nstr(x, 60) for x in gam], gamma_min=mp.nstr(min(gam), 30))
sqrt3 = mp.sqrt(3)
out["nodes_exact_check_maxabs"] = mp.nstr(max(abs(a-b) for a, b in zip(c, [-1, -(sqrt3-1), -(2-sqrt3), 2-sqrt3, sqrt3-1, 1])), 5)
# minimal polynomial check of sigma_sup (deg 5 integer poly): 4 x^5 - 5 x^4 - 1 = 0
out["sigma_sup_poly_residual(4x^5-5x^4-1)"] = mp.nstr(4*sigma_sup(s)**5-5*sigma_sup(s)**4-1, 5)
routes = {}
for sg in (MPF(1), MPF("1.2"), MPF("0.7"), MPF("0.1")):
    r1 = route1(c, gam, sg); r2 = route2(c, gam, sg); r3 = route3(c, g0, g1, sg)
    routes[mp.nstr(sg, 4)] = dict(
        B_r1_vs_r2=mp.nstr(mdiff(r1["B"], r2["B"]), 5), B_r1_vs_r3=mp.nstr(mdiff(r1["B"], r3["B"]), 5), B_r2_vs_r3=mp.nstr(mdiff(r2["B"], r3["B"]), 5),
        A_r1_vs_r2=mp.nstr(mdiff(r1["A"], r2["A"]), 5), Theta_r1_vs_r2=mp.nstr(mdiff(r1["Theta"], r2["Theta"]), 5),
        Gamma_plus_A=mp.nstr(mdiff(r1["Gamma"], -r1["A"]), 5))
out["route_agreement"] = routes
R = route2(c, gam, MPF(1)); R1 = route1(c, gam, MPF(1))
def tab(M, d=40): return [[mp.nstr(M[i, j], d) for j in range(M.cols)] for i in range(M.rows)]
out["tableau_sigma1"] = dict(B=tab(R["B"]), A=tab(R["A"]), Gamma=tab(-R["A"]), Theta=tab(R["Theta"]))
out["tableau_sigma1_route1_B_first_row_60"] = [mp.nstr(R1["B"][0, j], 60) for j in range(s)]
out["tableau_sigma1_route2_B_first_row_60"] = [mp.nstr(R["B"][0, j], 60) for j in range(s)]
Bn = mp2np(R["B"]); An = mp2np(R["A"]); gn = np.array([float(x) for x in gam]); cn = np.array([float(x) for x in c])
ev = np.linalg.eigvals(Bn); evs = sorted(ev, key=lambda z: -abs(z))
out["eig_B1_numeric"] = [complex(z).real for z in evs]
out["eig_B1_formula_sigma^(i-1)(1-(i-1)g1)"] = [float(mp.mpf(1)*(1-i*g1)) for i in range(s)]
out["max_abs_B1"] = float(abs(Bn).max()); out["max_abs_A1"] = float(abs(An).max())
out["row_sums_B1"] = list(Bn.sum(axis=1)); out["row_sums_B_ok(Preconsistency B1=1)"] = float(abs(Bn.sum(axis=1)-1).max())
# stiff accuracy: M(z)=(I-zG)^-1 (B+z beta), beta=A+Gamma=0
def Mz(B, z): return np.linalg.solve(np.eye(s)-z*np.diag(gn), B)
out["stiff_accuracy"] = dict(beta_norm=float(mp.nstr(mdiff(R["A"], R["A"]*0+R["A"]) * 0, 3)), rho_M_at_z=-1e6, val=rho(Mz(Bn, -1e6)), val_1e12=rho(Mz(Bn, -1e12)), note="beta=A+Gamma=0 by construction (BIT (2.7)); rho(M(z)) -> 0 as z -> -inf")
# L(alpha) angle for several sigma; ALSO the 1.1-wedge check of rho<1 on negative real axis
al = {}
for sg in (0.5, 0.8, 1.0, 1.1, 1.2, 1.3):
    Bs, _ = coef_np(cn, gn, sg); al[str(sg)] = dict(alpha_deg=round(alpha_deg(Bs, gn), 3),
          max_rho_on_negreal=max(rho(Mz(Bs, -x)) for x in np.logspace(-6, 9, 400)))

# dominant eigenvalue error vs exp(z): principal root order
def lam1(z):
    ev = np.linalg.eigvals(Mz(Bn, z)); return ev[np.argmin(abs(ev-np.exp(z)))]
pr = []
for h in (0.2, 0.1, 0.05, 0.025):
    pr.append((h, abs(lam1(-h)-np.exp(-h))))
out["principal_root_error_vs_exp"] = [dict(h=h, err=e) for h, e in pr]
out["principal_root_slopes"] = [float(np.log(pr[i][1]/pr[i+1][1])/np.log(2)) for i in range(len(pr)-1)]

# PW04 common library (literature + exact/numeric replay only).  python3 -I; numpy/scipy/mpmath.
import mpmath as mp, numpy as np, json, sys, hashlib
mp.mp.dps = 80
MPF = mp.mpf

# ---------- nodes / parameters ----------
def cheb_nodes(s):                      # BIT (5.8): c_i = cos((2s+1-2i)pi/(2s)) / cos(pi/(2s))
    return [mp.cos((2*s+1-2*i)*mp.pi/(2*s))/mp.cos(mp.pi/(2*s)) for i in range(1, s+1)]
def sigma_sup(s):                       # BIT Remark 2.1 : (s-2) x^(s-1) - (s-1) x^(s-2) - 1 = 0, root > 1
    f = lambda x: (s-2)*x**(s-1) - (s-1)*x**(s-2) - 1
    lo, hi = MPF(1), MPF(4)             # f(1) = -2 < 0 ; f(4) > 0 for s>=3
    for _ in range(300):
        mid = (lo+hi)/2
        if f(mid) > 0: hi = mid
        else: lo = mid
    return (lo+hi)/2
def g1_of(s): return 1 - 1/sigma_sup(s)  # (1-g1) sigma_sup = 1

# ---------- Route 1: BIT matrix formulas (2.4),(2.5) : Theta = V S P V^-1, E = V D F0^T V^-1, B = Theta - sigma A E ----------
def vander(c):
    s = len(c); return mp.matrix([[c[i]**j for j in range(s)] for i in range(s)])
def route1(c, gam, sg):
    s = len(c); V = vander(c); Vi = V**-1
    S = mp.diag([sg**j for j in range(s)])
    P = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s):
        for j in range(i, s): P[i, j] = mp.binomial(j, i)
    D = mp.diag([k+1 for k in range(s)])
    F0 = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(1, s): F0[i, i-1] = 1
    Th = V*S*P*Vi
    E = V*D*F0.T*Vi
    G = mp.diag(gam)
    Gm = -G*Th; A = -Gm
    B = Th - sg*A*E
    return dict(Theta=Th, Gamma=Gm, A=A, B=B, E=E)

# ---------- Route 2: direct Lagrange/polynomial form of Gamma(s),AB(s)  (BIT (3.1)); no Vandermonde inverse ----------
def lag(c, j, x):
    r = MPF(1)
    for k in range(len(c)):
        if k != j: r *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
    return r
def dlag(c, j, x):
    s = len(c); tot = MPF(0)
    for m in range(s):
        if m == j: continue
        t = 1/(c[j]-c[m])
        for k in range(s):
            if k != j and k != m: t *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
        tot += t
    return tot
def route2(c, gam, sg):
    s = len(c); Th = mp.matrix(s, s); B = mp.matrix(s, s); A = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s):
        x = 1+sg*c[i]
        for j in range(s):
            Th[i, j] = lag(c, j, x)
            A[i, j] = gam[i]*Th[i, j]                       # A = -Gamma = G Theta
            B[i, j] = Th[i, j] - gam[i]*sg*dlag(c, j, x)    # (3.1) AB: b_ij p(c_j) = p(1+sg c_i) - gam_i sg p'(1+sg c_i)
    return dict(Theta=Th, A=A, B=B)

# ---------- Route 3: BIT (2.15)  B~ = (I - g1 Dhat - g0 F0^T Dhat) S P, B = V B~ V^-1 ----------
def route3(c, g0, g1, sg):
    s = len(c); V = vander(c); Vi = V**-1
    S = mp.diag([sg**j for j in range(s)])
    P = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s):
        for j in range(i, s): P[i, j] = mp.binomial(j, i)
    Dh = mp.diag([k for k in range(s)])
    F0 = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(1, s): F0[i, i-1] = 1
    Bt = (mp.eye(s) - g1*Dh - g0*F0.T*Dh)*S*P
    return dict(Btilde=Bt, B=V*Bt*Vi, V=V, Vi=Vi)

def mdiff(X, Y): return max(abs(X[i, j]-Y[i, j]) for i in range(X.rows) for j in range(X.cols))
def mp2np(M): return np.array([[float(M[i, j]) for j in range(M.cols)] for i in range(M.rows)])

# ---------- (4.7) superconvergence condition on g0 ----------
def v_tilde(s, g0, g1):                 # left eigvec (size s+1) of the (s+1)x(s+1) triangular B~(sigma=1), eigenvalue 1, v1=1
    n = s+1
    S = mp.eye(n); P = mp.matrix(n, n)
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(i, n): P[i, j] = mp.binomial(j, i)
    Dh = mp.diag([k for k in range(n)]); F0 = mp.matrix(n, n)
    for i in range(1, n): F0[i, i-1] = 1
    Bt = (mp.eye(n) - g1*Dh - g0*F0.T*Dh)*S*P
    v = [MPF(0)]*n; v[0] = MPF(1)
    for j in range(1, n):
        acc = sum(v[i]*Bt[i, j] for i in range(j))
        v[j] = acc/(1-Bt[j, j])           # v_j (B~_jj - 1) + sum_{i<j} v_i B~_ij = 0
    return v
def resid47(c, g0, g1):                  # (4.7): v~ . (phi_0..phi_{s-1}, 1)
    s = len(c); v = v_tilde(s, g0, g1)
    # node polynomial coefficients phi_0..phi_s (phi_s = 1)
    co = [MPF(1)]
    for ci in c:
        new = [MPF(0)]*(len(co)+1)
        for k, a in enumerate(co): new[k+1] += a; new[k] -= ci*a
        co = new
    return sum(v[k]*co[k] for k in range(s+1))
def g0_roots_47(c, g1, lo=None, hi=4, n=800):
    # roots of a polynomial in g0 (degree <= s): interpolate exactly through s+1 points, then polyroots
    s = len(c); pts = [MPF(k)/2 for k in range(s+1)]
    vals = [resid47(c, p, g1) for p in pts]
    # Newton-form -> monomial via solving Vandermonde
    Vm = mp.matrix([[p**k for k in range(s+1)] for p in pts]); co = mp.lu_solve(Vm, mp.matrix(vals))
    rts = mp.polyroots([co[k] for k in range(s, -1, -1)], maxsteps=500, extraprec=400)
    return sorted([mp.re(r) for r in rts if abs(mp.im(r)) < mp.mpf(10)**-40], key=lambda x: x)
# alternative route for g0 :  v^T w = 0 with v left eigvec (v^T 1 = 1) of nodal B(1) and w_i = phi(1+c_i) - gam_i phi'(1+c_i)   (BIT (4.5))
def resid_nodal(c, g0, g1):
    s = len(c); gam = [g0+g1*ci for ci in c]
    B = route2(c, gam, MPF(1))['B']
    Bn = mp2np(B)
    # left eigenvector for eigenvalue 1 by exact solve in mp:  v^T (B - I) = 0, v^T 1 = 1
    M = (B - mp.eye(s)).T
    M2 = mp.matrix(s, s)
    for i in range(s-1):
        for j in range(s): M2[i, j] = M[i, j]
    for j in range(s): M2[s-1, j] = 1
    rhs = mp.matrix([0]*(s-1)+[1]); v = mp.lu_solve(M2, rhs)
    phi = lambda x: mp.fprod([x-ci for ci in c])
    dphi = lambda x: mp.fsum(mp.fprod([x-ck for k, ck in enumerate(c) if k != m]) for m in range(s))
    w = [phi(1+c[i]) - gam[i]*dphi(1+c[i]) for i in range(s)]
    return mp.fsum(v[i]*w[i] for i in range(s))

# ---------- numpy (double) coefficient evaluation for experiments ----------
def lag_np(c, x):
    s = len(c); L = np.ones((len(x), s)); dL = np.zeros((len(x), s))
    for j in range(s):
        for k in range(s):
            if k != j: L[:, j] *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
        for m in range(s):
            if m == j: continue
            t = np.ones(len(x))/(c[j]-c[m])
            for k in range(s):
                if k != j and k != m: t *= (x-c[k])/(c[j]-c[k])
            dL[:, j] += t
    return L, dL
def coef_np(c, gam, sg):
    c = np.asarray(c, float); gam = np.asarray(gam, float)
    x = 1+sg*c; L, dL = lag_np(c, x)
    A = gam[:, None]*L; B = L - gam[:, None]*sg*dL
    return B, A
def alpha_deg(B, gam, nphi=721, nr=500, rlo=-6, rhi=10):
    rs = np.logspace(rlo, rhi, nr); g = np.asarray(gam, float)
    def f(p):
        z = rs*np.exp(1j*(np.pi-np.radians(p)))
        M = (1.0/(1.0-z[:, None]*g[None, :]))[:, :, None]*B[None, :, :]
        return float(np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(M))))
    prev = 0.0
    for p in np.linspace(0, 90, nphi):
        if f(p) >= 1+1e-13:
            lo, hi = prev, p
            for _ in range(40):
                m = 0.5*(lo+hi)
                if f(m) >= 1+1e-13: hi = m
                else: lo = m
            return lo
        prev = p
    return 90.0
def rho(M): return float(np.max(np.abs(np.linalg.eigvals(M))))

# ---------- method definitions ----------
P26 = dict(c=["-1.702","-0.51","-0.195797762","0.155193392","0.755672784","1"],
  g0=["0.214789562","0.249182503","0.237832565","0.245204742","0.353848357"],
  g1=["0.566334104","0.496228487","0.518584061","0.498857638","0.502412430"])   # APNUM 48 PPSW2-6 (PW03A/PW03B recovery)
def gam_ppsw2(c, g0, g1, sg):            # APNUM (3.8) i<s ; (3.6) i=s
    s = len(c); g = [g0[i]/(1+sg*g1[i]) for i in range(s-1)]
    g.append(1/(sg*sum(1/(1+sg-cj) for cj in c))); return g
def mipeer_params(s, g0=None):
    c = cheb_nodes(s); g1 = g1_of(s)
    if g0 is None:
        rts = g0_roots_47(c, g1); lb = -g1*min(c)
        g0 = [r for r in rts if r > lb][0]
    return c, g0, g1
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b if isinstance(b, bytes) else b.encode()).hexdigest()
# PW04-M3: variable-step order conditions Gamma(q), AB(q) (BIT (2.2),(2.3)) residual tables for mipeer6 (B from Route 1) and PPSW2-6 (comparison).
mp.mp.dps = 80
def residuals(c, gam, B, A, sg, kmax=9):
    s = len(c); u = [(cj-1)/sg for cj in c]; rg = []; rab = []
    for k in range(kmax+1):
        eg = max(abs(gam[i]*c[i]**k - mp.fsum(A[i, j]*u[j]**k for j in range(s))) for i in range(s))
        ea = max(abs(c[i]**k - mp.fsum(B[i, j]*u[j]**k for j in range(s)) - (k*mp.fsum(A[i, j]*u[j]**(k-1) for j in range(s)) if k >= 1 else 0)) for i in range(s))
        rg.append(eg); rab.append(ea)
    return rg, rab
sigs = [MPF(x) for x in ("0.1", "0.5", "0.8", "1", "1.2", "1.33", "2")]
out = {}
s = 6
c, g0, g1 = mipeer_params(s); gam = [g0+g1*x for x in c]
tab = {}
for sg in sigs:
    r1 = route1(c, gam, sg); rg, rab = residuals(c, gam, r1["B"], r1["A"], sg)
    tab[mp.nstr(sg, 4)] = dict(Gamma_k=[mp.nstr(x, 3) for x in rg], AB_k=[mp.nstr(x, 3) for x in rab])
out["mipeer6_residual_max_over_stages_k0..9"] = tab
# leading error vector: (4.2) bracket  W_i = phi(1+sg c_i) - gam_i sg phi'(1+sg c_i)   vs  (4.1) bracket Z_i  vs  sg^s * res_AB(s)_i
phi = lambda x: mp.fprod([x-ci for ci in c]); dphi = lambda x: mp.fsum(mp.fprod([x-ck for k, ck in enumerate(c) if k != m]) for m in range(s))
lead = {}
for sg in (MPF(1), MPF("1.2"), MPF("0.7")):
    r1 = route1(c, gam, sg); B = r1["B"]; A = r1["A"]
    W = [phi(1+sg*c[i]) - gam[i]*sg*dphi(1+sg*c[i]) for i in range(s)]
    Z = [(1+sg*c[i])**s - mp.fsum(B[i, j]*c[j]**s for j in range(s)) - sg*s*mp.fsum(-A[i, j]*c[j]**(s-1) for j in range(s)) for i in range(s)]
    Zt = [(1+sg*c[i])**s - mp.fsum(B[i, j]*c[j]**s for j in range(s)) - sg*s*mp.fsum(A[i, j]*c[j]**(s-1) for j in range(s)) for i in range(s)]
    u = [(cj-1)/sg for cj in c]
    R = [c[i]**s - mp.fsum(B[i, j]*u[j]**s for j in range(s)) - s*mp.fsum(A[i, j]*u[j]**(s-1) for j in range(s)) for i in range(s)]
    lead[mp.nstr(sg, 4)] = dict(W_4_2=[mp.nstr(x, 12) for x in W], Z_printed_gamma_ij_eq_minus_a_ij_minus_W=mp.nstr(max(abs(Z[i]-W[i]) for i in range(s)), 4), Z_taylor_with_minus_sigma_s_sum_a_ij_minus_W=mp.nstr(max(abs(Zt[i]-W[i]) for i in range(s)), 4),
        sg_pow_s_times_resAB_s_minus_W_maxabs=mp.nstr(max(abs(sg**s*R[i]-W[i]) for i in range(s)), 4), min_abs_W=mp.nstr(min(abs(x) for x in W), 6), max_abs_W=mp.nstr(max(abs(x) for x in W), 6))
out["leading_error_vector_(4.1)(4.2)_check"] = lead
# can a method of this form (g linear) reach AB(s+1)?  Look for g0 (g1 fixed) that zeros W_i for ALL i: min over g0 of max_i |W_i| at sigma=1
def maxW(g0x):
    gm = [g0x+g1*x for x in c]; return max(abs(phi(1+c[i]) - gm[i]*dphi(1+c[i])) for i in range(s))
gs = [MPF(k)/50 for k in range(-20, 200)]
vals = [(maxW(g), g) for g in gs]; best = min(vals)
out["order_s_attainability_in_subclass"] = dict(best_g0_on_grid=mp.nstr(best[1], 6), min_over_g0_max_i_abs_W=mp.nstr(best[0], 8),
    note="AB(s+1) would need W_i=0 for all i with only (g0,g1); stage s alone can be zeroed via (2.12) (BIT) but not all stages", stage_s_alone_zero_g0=None)
# (2.12): gamma_s from 1/gamma_s = sigma * sum_j 1/(1+sigma-c_j) -> g0 needed for superconsistent last stage (not used by mipeer6)
sg = MPF(1); g_s_212 = 1/(sg*mp.fsum(1/(1+sg-cj) for cj in c)); out["eq_2_12_gamma_s_needed"] = mp.nstr(g_s_212, 15); out["gamma_s_mipeer6"] = mp.nstr(gam[-1], 15)
out["eq_2_12_g0_needed_if_used"] = mp.nstr(g_s_212-g1*c[-1], 15)
# PPSW2-6 (comparison): residuals from Route 2 B,A with APNUM gamma_i(sigma)
c26 = [MPF(x) for x in P26["c"]]; g026 = [MPF(x) for x in P26["g0"]]; g126 = [MPF(x) for x in P26["g1"]]
t2 = {}
for sg in sigs:
    gm = gam_ppsw2(c26, g026, g126, sg); r2 = route2(c26, gm, sg); rg, rab = residuals(c26, gm, r2["B"], r2["A"], sg)
    t2[mp.nstr(sg, 4)] = dict(Gamma_k=[mp.nstr(x, 3) for x in rg], AB_k=[mp.nstr(x, 3) for x in rab])
out["PPSW2-6_residual_max_over_stages_k0..9"] = t2
print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
